statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-45919 reports a buffer over-read in glXQueryServerString() in Mesa's GLX client code: __glXQueryServerString() copies the server's reply string using the length the X server sends, without checking it against the size of the reply (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/issues/9858). The CVE record is tagged disputed because there are no common situations in which users require uninterrupted operation with an attacker-controlled server (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-45919), but it does not say who disputed it, and the upstream issue is still open with no response from the Mesa developers, so there is no upstream ruling to rely on. The published mesa package ships Mesa's GLX client library as libGLX_mesa.so.0 in libglx-mesa0, built from Mesa 25.0.7 with the Debian 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 changes. The unchecked copy is still present in src/glx/glx_query.c of Mesa 25.0.7. Debian tracks it as unimportant and unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-45919). Pending: a ruling or fix from Mesa on issue 9858.
